fix: "At a minimum, a platform holding digital assets should have multiple layers of security so no single compromise, such as a hacked employee laptop, can authorize a transfer," says Tim Rawlins, senior adviser and director of security at NCC Group. Developers and administrators should have privileged access workstations to ensure systems they used for critical operations are separate from those they use for other activities such as email and Web browsing, he says. Also critical is 24/7 monitoring for anomalous behavior to help detect compromised endpoints and suspicious activity before attackers can exploit privileged access.
